name: Aria properties allocated on first use

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Aria properties allocated on first use

Mechanism: every `Interactivity` held 328 bytes of ARIA properties inline; allocate them when the first is set (`LazyAria`, reading an unset one reads a shared default). Allowed: elements/div.rs.
measurementPlanMarkdown: alt2.sh over six scenarios; heap peak on div-cards. Pass: nothing slower, heap not higher.

measurements.metric: geomean of six scenarios, CPU / draw p50
